title: 3 BOOKS INCLUDING EROTIC
findings: Three books, all titles read. (1) The Illustrated Manual of Sex Therapy, Helen Singer Kaplan M.D., Ph.D., hardback in red and black dust jacket (first published 1975; publisher and edition not visible). (2) The Complete Book of Sexual Love, large-format hardback in pictorial dust jacket, spine reads 'The Complete ... [script title]' (author, publisher and date not visible, looks 1970s-80s coffee-table issue). (3) Ten Little Nigger Boys, illustrated by Nora Case, small pocket hardback with orange and white pictorial boards and silhouette illustration on front; publisher and date not visible in the photo (no title page or back shown), style suggests c.1930s-1950s British printing. Items 1 and 2 are common mass-printed titles worth little. Item 3 is the only one of interest: an early illustrated children's counting-rhyme book with a specialist collector market (black memorabilia and early children's books). No price confirmed (web search found no sales record), likely tens rather than hundreds of dollars, so worth a quick sold-price check only. Only one photo, so no title pages, imprints or edition statements could be checked.
condition: Kaplan: jacket edges lightly worn, small tears top edge. Sexual Love: jacket rubbed at top edge, otherwise fair. Nora Case book: boards worn and rubbed at corners and edges, spine wear, soiling; interior not shown.
reason: Nora Case 'Ten Little Nigger Boys' early illustrated children's book has a specialist collector market; other two books are common and worth little.
